title: A finite projective module is free after localizing away from each prime
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a finite projective $A$-module, i.e. $M$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$ there exists an element $f\in A\setminus\mathfrak p$ such that the localization $M_f$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is a finite free $A_f$-module, i.e. $M_f\cong A_f^{\oplus r}$ as $A_f$-modules for some integer $r\ge0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective, line 19027), implication (3)\Rightarrow(7): the finite locally free standard-open neighbourhood of each prime

proof.text: $M$ is finitely presented: since $M$ is finitely generated and projective, a surjection $A^{\oplus n}\to M$ splits, its kernel $K$ is a direct summand of $A^{\oplus n}$, hence finitely generated, and $A^{\oplus m}\to A^{\oplus n}\to M\to0$ is exact for a surjection $A^{\oplus m}\to K$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-finitely-presented]. In Lean, install Module.FinitePresentation A M using Module.finitePresentation_of_projective A M.

Fix the prime $\mathfrak p$. Since $M$ is finite projective, its localization $M_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is a finite free module over the local ring $A_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-rank-locally-constant, first clause]; say $M_{\mathfrak p}\cong A_{\mathfrak p}^{\oplus r}$. In Lean, localization preserves finiteness and flatness by instances; Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing gives freeness, and Module.finBasis chooses a basis indexed by Fin (Module.finrank (Localization.AtPrime p) (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M)). Only the stalk-freeness clause of the cited rank lemma is used.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective, line 19027): (2)$\Rightarrow$(1)$\Rightarrow$(7)$\Rightarrow$(4), $M_{\mathfrak p}$ free for every prime

proof.text: Apply the basis-lifting form of [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-free-at-prime-spreads], namely Module.FinitePresentation.exists_basis_localizedModule_powers, with S = p.primeCompl, the map LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.primeCompl M, the ring Localization.AtPrime p, and the finite basis from step 2. It returns f in p.primeCompl and a basis of LocalizedModule.Away f M over Localization.Away f with the same finite index set. Membership in p.primeCompl is definitionally f not in p. The coordinate equivalence b'.repr of this lifted basis proves M_f is isomorphic to the direct sum of r copies of A_f [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away].

proof_origin.place: Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective, line 19027), (2)$\Rightarrow$(3)$\Rightarrow$(1) for finite presentation and freeness of $M_{\mathfrak p}$; Lemma Tag 0GWM (lemma-finitely-presented-localization-free, line 19447) for spreading freeness from $\mathfrak p$ to $D(f)$. Stacks proves (1)$\Rightarrow$(7) of 00NX directly by Nakayama (line 19073); 0GWM is the same conclusion for a finitely presented module free at $\mathfrak p$, and is the form Mathlib has. Lean realization by C2 on 2026-10-12 uses the basis-lifting form exists_basis_localizedModule_powers of the same spreading argument, followed by Basis.repr; the three-step route and proof dependencies are unchanged.

Proof in three steps following Stacks: 00NX (2)=>(3)=>(1) gives finite presentation (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-finitely-presented, Module.finitePresentation_of_projective); M_p finite free by the existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-rank-locally-constant; Stacks Lemma 0GWM spreads freeness from p to some D(f) (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-free-at-prime-spreads, exists_free_localizedModule_powers with S = A minus p plus Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule). algebra.tex is present in this checkout (the citer's split said it was absent), so the proof is by document.
